description: This file is a shell script (probably a test or utility script) for testing and managing Git maintenance tasks. It includes functions and test cases for various maintenance operations such as repacking, pruning, registering/unregistering maintenance configs, managing scheduled tasks on different platforms, and verifying configurations.

methods.name: test_expect_worktree_prune
methods.description: Function to test the worktree prune operation with or without the --auto flag, considering the presence of prunable worktrees and gc worktree prune expiration.

methods.name: test_rerere_gc
methods.description: Function to test the rerere garbage collection task, considering the --auto flag and the presence of cache entries.

methods.name: run_incremental_repack_and_verify
methods.description: Function to perform a series of commits, repacks, and index manipulations to verify the incremental-repack maintenance task works as expected.

methods.name: run_and_verify_geometric_pack
methods.description: Function to verify that geometric repacking operation produces the expected number of pack files and no loose objects.

methods.name: test_geometric_repack_needed
methods.description: Checks whether geometric repacking is needed based on current pack layout and configuration, and verifies the trace contains a repack command when needed.

methods.name: test_strategy
methods.description: Executes maintenance run with a specific strategy, captures the child process command, and compares the observed commands against expected patterns.
